title: Nell's Race
checkpoint: Phase 1 (Introduction) — a wordless story for sharing and talking through together; there are no sounds to decode yet.
note_for_grown_ups: A gentle story about what matters more than winning — a nice one to talk about kindness and helping a friend, even when it costs you the race.

pages.talk_prompt: Nell and Pip are lined up ready to race across the stream — who do you think will win?
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow side by side at the edge of a stream, both poised and ready to race.

pages.talk_prompt: They are off — who is ahead?
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow flying just ahead of Nell the bee, both racing low over the rushing stream.

pages.talk_prompt: Pip has reached the other side first, but Nell has stopped — what has she noticed?
pages.illustration: Nell the bee pausing mid-race over the stream, noticing a small brown beetle struggling on a floating leaf.

pages.talk_prompt: Nell is helping the beetle instead of racing — what is she doing?
pages.illustration: Nell the bee carefully nudging a small brown beetle from a floating leaf onto a safe leaf by the bank.

pages.talk_prompt: Nell has finished last — how do you think she feels?
pages.illustration: Nell the bee landing on the far bank of the stream last, looking a little glum, while Pip the sparrow waits.

pages.talk_prompt: Pip does not seem to mind that Nell was last — why do you think that is?
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow smiling and giving Nell the bee a gentle wing-nudge, the rescued beetle safe on the bank nearby.
